sources.citation: Pick, Andrew. 2020. A Reconstruction of Proto-Northern Adelbert Phonology and Lexicon. PhD dissertation, University of Hawai'i at Manoa. 486 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sec. 1.5.1 'Stress' (pp. 31-32): stress has been described only for Mauwake, Pamosu and Usan; 'the available data on stress in most languages are minimal or nonexistent'. Fn. 10 p. 31 and p. 140: the Ukuriguma analysis rests solely on Z'graggen's 1980 wordlist transcriptions. Sec. 4.5 Ukuriguma (p. 158) gives only vowel/consonant inventories, final devoicing of /b/, [s] allophone of /t/; nothing on stress.
